variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'wherewith he made Israel to sin' renders a hiphil of חטא; the ketiv החטי is a defective spelling of the same verb, so the English does not distinguish it from the qere הֶחֱטִיא. The verse's only note (hebrew_gloss, 'he walked') maps to a different word. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
